creators.name: Ubisoft Montreal
creators.role_zh: 育碧旗下游戏工作室，蒙特利尔
creators.bio: Large Ubisoft studio known for Assassin's Creed and Far Cry; its Fun House team made the early VR title Eagle Flight.
creators.bio_zh: 育碧的大型工作室，以《刺客信条》《孤岛惊魂》闻名；其 Fun House 团队制作了早期 VR 游戏 Eagle Flight。
creators.why: Eagle Flight was one of the first commercial VR games built entirely around flying as an animal.
creators.why_zh: Eagle Flight 是最早一批完全围绕“以动物身份飞行”设计的商业 VR 游戏之一。

creators.name: Firepunchd Games
creators.role_zh: 独立 VR 游戏工作室，德国
creators.bio: Small German studio that made the VR physics game Tentacular, published by Devolver Digital.
creators.bio_zh: 德国小型工作室，制作了由 Devolver Digital 发行的 VR 物理游戏 Tentacular。
creators.why: Tentacular turns the player's hands into boneless tentacles, a direct design study for octopus-like limbs in VR.
creators.why_zh: Tentacular 把玩家的双手变成没有骨头的触手，是 VR 中章鱼式肢体的直接设计案例。

creators.name: Another Axiom
creators.role: VR game studio behind Gorilla Tag
creators.role_zh: Gorilla Tag 背后的 VR 游戏工作室
creators.bio: Studio founded around Gorilla Tag, the social VR game first made by Kerestell "Lemming" Smith.
creators.bio_zh: 围绕 Gorilla Tag 成立的工作室，该社交 VR 游戏最初由 Kerestell “Lemming” Smith 独立开发。
creators.why: Gorilla Tag showed that an ape-like, arm-driven body can become a mass-market VR locomotion scheme.
creators.why_zh: Gorilla Tag 证明了类人猿式、用手臂驱动的身体可以成为大众化的 VR 移动方式。

creators.name: New Folder Games
creators.role: VR game studio making 'I Am' animal simulators
creators.role_zh: 制作“I Am”系列动物模拟游戏的 VR 工作室
creators.bio: Studio behind a line of VR sandbox games titled I Am Cat, I Am Bird and I Am Monkey, each built around one animal body.
creators.bio_zh: 开发 I Am Cat、I Am Bird、I Am Monkey 等 VR 沙盒游戏的工作室，每一款都围绕一种动物身体展开。
creators.why: Its series is the most direct commercial attempt to sell 'being an animal' as the whole premise of a VR game.
creators.why_zh: 这一系列是最直接把“成为动物”本身当作 VR 游戏卖点的商业尝试。

creators.name: David Chaseling
creators.role_zh: 独立 VR 开发者
creators.bio: Independent developer who co-created the VR octopus platformer I Am Octopus with Dylan Van Beek.
creators.bio_zh: 独立开发者，与 Dylan Van Beek 共同开发了 VR 章鱼平台游戏 I Am Octopus。
creators.why: I Am Octopus builds locomotion entirely out of stretching and sticking tentacles.
creators.why_zh: I Am Octopus 的移动方式完全由伸展和吸附触手构成。

creators.name: Treta Studios
creators.role_zh: VR 游戏工作室，印度
creators.bio: Indian VR studio that made Be A Chameleon for Meta Quest and Steam.
creators.bio_zh: 印度 VR 工作室，为 Meta Quest 和 Steam 开发了 Be A Chameleon。
creators.why: Be A Chameleon turns camouflage and a sticky tongue into the player's main verbs.
creators.why_zh: Be A Chameleon 把伪装和黏性舌头变成玩家的主要动作。

creators.name: Gattai Games
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室，新加坡
creators.bio: Singapore studio that grew out of a student project into the echolocation horror game Stifled.
creators.bio_zh: 新加坡工作室，由学生项目发展出回声定位恐怖游戏 Stifled。
creators.why: Stifled lets players see only by making sound into a real microphone, a playable form of echolocation.
creators.why_zh: Stifled 让玩家只能通过对着真实麦克风发声来“看见”，是可玩的回声定位。

creators.name: The Deep End Games
creators.role: Independent game studio founded by former BioShock developers
creators.role_zh: 由前 BioShock 开发者创立的独立游戏工作室
creators.bio: Studio founded by Bill and Amanda Gardner and other former Irrational Games staff; made Perception.
creators.bio_zh: 由 Bill 与 Amanda Gardner 等前 Irrational Games 成员创立，开发了 Perception。
creators.why: Perception's echo-vision rendering is a widely cited visual reference for depicting echolocation.
creators.why_zh: Perception 的“回声视觉”渲染是表现回声定位时常被引用的视觉参考。

creators.name: Manekoware
creators.role: Independent game studio of Chris Chung
creators.role_zh: Chris Chung 的独立游戏工作室
creators.bio: One-person studio of Chris Chung, who made the first-person cat game Catlateral Damage, later co-developed with Fire Hose Games.
creators.bio_zh: Chris Chung 的个人工作室，制作了第一人称猫咪游戏 Catlateral Damage，后与 Fire Hose Games 合作开发。
creators.why: Catlateral Damage is an early first-person animal game with optional VR support.
creators.why_zh: Catlateral Damage 是较早的第一人称动物游戏，并支持可选的 VR 模式。

creators.name: David OReilly
creators.role: Irish artist, animator and game maker
creators.role_zh: 爱尔兰艺术家、动画师与游戏创作者
creators.bio: Irish-born artist working across animation, games and installation; made the games Mountain and Everything and the alien software in the film Her.
creators.bio_zh: 出生于爱尔兰的艺术家，横跨动画、游戏与装置；创作了游戏 Mountain 与 Everything，并为电影《她》设计了游戏片段。
creators.why: His games let players be a mountain or any object in the universe, the clearest game-art statement on becoming things.
creators.why_zh: 他的游戏让玩家成为一座山或宇宙中的任何事物，是游戏艺术中关于“成为物”最清晰的表达。

creators.name: Might and Delight
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室，斯德哥尔摩
creators.bio: Swedish studio behind the Shelter series, in which players live as animal parents: a badger, a lynx, an elephant.
creators.bio_zh: 瑞典工作室，开发了 Shelter 系列，玩家以动物父母的身份生活：獾、猞猁、大象。
creators.why: The Shelter games are the longest-running series built around animal care, vulnerability and herd life.
creators.why_zh: Shelter 系列是围绕动物育幼、脆弱与群体生活持续最久的游戏系列。

creators.name: BlueTwelve Studio
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室，法国南部
creators.bio: Studio founded by Koola and Viv, whose first game Stray casts the player as a cat in a city of robots.
creators.bio_zh: 由 Koola 与 Viv 创立的工作室，首作 Stray 让玩家扮演一只身处机器人城市的猫。
creators.why: Stray is the most widely played game about moving through the world with a cat's body and affordances.
creators.why_zh: Stray 是以猫的身体与行动可能性穿行世界、玩家最多的游戏。

creators.name: Double Dagger Studio
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室，西雅图
creators.bio: Small studio founded by former Valve designer Matt T. Wood; made Little Kitty, Big City.
creators.bio_zh: 由前 Valve 设计师 Matt T. Wood 创立的小型工作室，开发了 Little Kitty, Big City。
creators.why: Little Kitty, Big City reframes a city at kitten scale.
creators.why_zh: Little Kitty, Big City 以小猫的尺度重新呈现城市。

creators.name: House House
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室，墨尔本
creators.bio: Four-person Melbourne studio behind Push Me Pull You and Untitled Goose Game.
creators.bio_zh: 墨尔本的四人工作室，作品有 Push Me Pull You 与 Untitled Goose Game。
creators.why: Untitled Goose Game is the popular counterpoint: an animal body used for comedy rather than perception.
creators.why_zh: Untitled Goose Game 是大众化的对照：动物身体被用于喜剧而非感知。

creators.name: Young Horses
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室，芝加哥
creators.bio: Studio formed by DePaul University students after their student game Octodad (2010).
creators.bio_zh: 由德保罗大学学生在学生作品 Octodad（2010）之后组建的工作室。
creators.why: Octodad made the mismatch between an octopus body and human routines the core control problem.
creators.why_zh: Octodad 把章鱼身体与人类日常之间的错位变成了核心操控难题。

creators.name: Ed Annunziata
creators.role: Game designer, creator of Ecco the Dolphin
creators.role_zh: 游戏设计师，Ecco the Dolphin 的创作者
creators.bio: Sega designer who conceived Ecco the Dolphin (1992), developed with Novotrade International.
creators.bio_zh: 世嘉设计师，构想了 Ecco the Dolphin（1992），与 Novotrade International 共同开发。
creators.why: Ecco is the landmark game that made echolocation a core game mechanic.
creators.why_zh: Ecco 是把回声定位变成核心游戏机制的里程碑作品。

creators.name: Tripwire Interactive
creators.role_zh: 游戏开发与发行商，美国佐治亚州
creators.bio: Developer and publisher known for Killing Floor and Maneater.
creators.bio_zh: 以 Killing Floor 与 Maneater 闻名的开发与发行商。
creators.why: Maneater is the shark power-fantasy counterpoint to contemplative animal games.
creators.why_zh: Maneater 是与沉思型动物游戏相对的鲨鱼“力量幻想”。
creators.based_zh: 罗斯威尔，佐治亚州，美国

creators.name: VARSAV Game Studios
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室，华沙
creators.bio: Polish studio that made Bee Simulator and its sequel Bee Simulator: The Hive.
creators.bio_zh: 波兰工作室，开发了 Bee Simulator 及续作 Bee Simulator: The Hive。
creators.why: Bee Simulator is a family-oriented attempt to gamify bee senses and the waggle dance.
creators.why_zh: Bee Simulator 面向家庭玩家，尝试把蜜蜂的感官与摇摆舞游戏化。

creators.name: Infuse Studio
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室，阿德莱德
creators.bio: Small Australian studio behind Spirit of the North and its sequel.
creators.bio_zh: 澳大利亚小型工作室，开发了 Spirit of the North 及续作。
creators.why: Its fox games are wordless journeys through landscape seen from an animal's height.
creators.why_zh: 它的狐狸游戏是以动物视角高度穿越风景的无言旅程。

creators.name: Mooneye Studios
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室，汉堡
creators.bio: German studio that made Lost Ember, a game about a wolf who can inhabit other animals.
creators.bio_zh: 德国工作室，开发了 Lost Ember，讲述一只能附身其他动物的狼。
creators.why: Lost Ember is built on switching between animal bodies, each with its own way of moving.
creators.why_zh: Lost Ember 的核心是在不同动物身体之间切换，每种身体有各自的移动方式。

creators.name: Coffee Stain Studios
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室，舍夫德
creators.bio: Swedish studio behind Goat Simulator and Satisfactory.
creators.bio_zh: 瑞典工作室，作品包括 Goat Simulator 与 Satisfactory。
creators.why: Goat Simulator is the parody counterpoint to animal simulation.
creators.why_zh: Goat Simulator 是动物模拟类型的戏仿对照。

creators.name: eduweb
creators.role_zh: 教育游戏开发商，明尼苏达州
creators.bio: Educational media company that created WolfQuest with the Minnesota Zoo, first funded by the US National Science Foundation.
creators.bio_zh: 教育媒体公司，与明尼苏达动物园合作开发 WolfQuest，最初由美国国家科学基金会资助。
creators.why: WolfQuest is the longest-running science-based game about living as a wild wolf.
creators.why_zh: WolfQuest 是以科学为基础、以野狼身份生活的持续时间最长的游戏。
creators.based_zh: 圣保罗，明尼苏达州，美国

creators.name: Bossa Studios
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室，伦敦
creators.bio: London studio known for physics-comedy games such as Surgeon Simulator and I Am Bread.
creators.bio_zh: 伦敦工作室，以 Surgeon Simulator、I Am Bread 等物理喜剧游戏闻名。
creators.why: I Am Bread is the best-known game about controlling an everyday object as a body.
creators.why_zh: I Am Bread 是把日常物件当作身体来操控的最知名游戏。

creators.name: thatgamecompany
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室，洛杉矶
creators.bio: Studio co-founded by Jenova Chen and Kellee Santiago; made flOw, Flower, Journey and Sky.
creators.bio_zh: 由陈星汉与 Kellee Santiago 共同创立，作品有 flOw、Flower、Journey 与 Sky。
creators.why: In flOw you are a microorganism and in Flower you are the wind: two early art games of nonhuman bodies.
creators.why_zh: 在 flOw 中你是微生物，在 Flower 中你是风：两部早期的非人身体艺术游戏。

creators.name: Hemisphere Games
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室，多伦多
creators.bio: Toronto studio founded by Eddy Boxerman; made Osmos.
creators.bio_zh: 由 Eddy Boxerman 创立的多伦多工作室，开发了 Osmos。
creators.why: Osmos makes a single cell-like body obey physics: every move costs part of yourself.
creators.why_zh: Osmos 让一个类似细胞的身体服从物理：每次移动都要付出自身的一部分。

creators.name: Maxis
creators.role_zh: 模拟游戏工作室，加利福尼亚
creators.bio: Studio co-founded by Will Wright and Jeff Braun; made SimCity, SimAnt, The Sims and Spore.
creators.bio_zh: 由 Will Wright 与 Jeff Braun 共同创立，作品有 SimCity、SimAnt、The Sims 与 Spore。
creators.why: SimAnt and Spore are the classic simulation games of colony life and self-designed creature bodies.
creators.why_zh: SimAnt 与 Spore 是关于蚁群生活与自创生物身体的经典模拟游戏。

creators.name: Untame
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室，以色列
creators.bio: Small studio of Itay Keren and Julia Keren-Detar; made Mushroom 11.
creators.bio_zh: 由 Itay Keren 与 Julia Keren-Detar 组成的小型工作室，开发了 Mushroom 11。
creators.why: Mushroom 11 is the key game about controlling an amorphous, regrowing organism.
creators.why_zh: Mushroom 11 是操控无定形、可再生有机体的关键游戏。

creators.name: Phobia Game Studio
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室，波兰
creators.bio: Polish studio that made the reverse-horror game Carrion, published by Devolver Digital.
creators.bio_zh: 波兰工作室，开发了由 Devolver Digital 发行的“反向恐怖”游戏 Carrion。
creators.why: Carrion lets players be a tentacled mass that grows and squeezes through vents.
creators.why_zh: Carrion 让玩家成为一团会生长、能挤过通风管的触手肉块。

creators.name: Sbug Games
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室
creators.bio: Small studio that made the spider platformer Webbed and its spin-off Isopod.
creators.bio_zh: 小型工作室，开发了蜘蛛平台游戏 Webbed 及衍生作 Isopod。
creators.why: Webbed turns spider silk into a physically simulated extension of the body.
creators.why_zh: Webbed 把蛛丝变成物理模拟的身体延伸。

creators.name: Tower Five
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室，法国
creators.bio: French studio that made Empire of the Ants for publisher Microids.
creators.bio_zh: 法国工作室，为发行商 Microids 开发了 Empire of the Ants。
creators.why: Empire of the Ants renders the forest floor photorealistically at ant scale.
creators.why_zh: Empire of the Ants 以照片级真实感呈现蚂蚁尺度下的森林地面。

creators.name: Sumo Digital
creators.role_zh: 游戏开发商，谢菲尔德
creators.bio: Large British developer; its internal game jam produced Snake Pass.
creators.bio_zh: 英国大型开发商，内部 Game Jam 催生了 Snake Pass。
creators.why: Snake Pass is the reference game for a limbless body that moves by coiling and gripping.
creators.why_zh: Snake Pass 是无肢身体通过盘绕与抓握移动的参考游戏。

creators.name: Herobeat Studios
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室，西班牙
creators.bio: Spanish studio that made Endling - Extinction is Forever.
creators.bio_zh: 西班牙工作室，开发了 Endling - Extinction is Forever。
creators.why: Endling tells extinction from inside a fox family.
creators.why_zh: Endling 从一个狐狸家庭内部讲述物种灭绝。

creators.name: Breaking Walls
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室
creators.bio: Studio that made AWAY: The Survival Series, a game styled as a nature documentary.
creators.bio_zh: 开发了 AWAY: The Survival Series 的工作室，该游戏采用自然纪录片风格。
creators.why: AWAY plays with the nature-documentary voice while the player is the animal.
creators.why_zh: AWAY 借用自然纪录片的叙述方式，而玩家本身就是那只动物。

creators.name: Videocult
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室
creators.bio: Studio of Joar Jakobsson and James Therrien (James Primate); made Rain World.
creators.bio_zh: 由 Joar Jakobsson 与 James Therrien（James Primate）组成的工作室，开发了 Rain World。
creators.why: Rain World simulates an ecosystem of autonomous creatures in which the player is small prey.
creators.why_zh: Rain World 模拟了一个由自主生物组成的生态系统，玩家只是其中弱小的猎物。

creators.name: Clover Studio
creators.role_zh: 卡普空旗下游戏工作室，大阪（2004–2007）
creators.bio: Short-lived Capcom studio led by Atsushi Inaba and Hideki Kamiya; made Viewtiful Joe and Ōkami.
creators.bio_zh: 卡普空旗下的短命工作室，由稻叶敦志与神谷英树主导，作品有《红侠乔伊》与《大神》。
creators.why: Ōkami casts the player as a sun goddess in the body of a white wolf who restores nature by painting.
creators.why_zh: 《大神》让玩家以白狼之身化身太阳女神，用绘画让自然复苏。

creators.name: Awaceb
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室，蒙特利尔
creators.bio: Studio founded by Phil Crifo and Vincent Pierre-Toulouse from New Caledonia; made Tchia.
creators.bio_zh: 由来自新喀里多尼亚的 Phil Crifo 与 Vincent Pierre-Toulouse 创立，开发了 Tchia。
creators.why: Tchia's Soul Jump lets players inhabit any animal or object in the world.
creators.why_zh: Tchia 的“灵魂跳跃”让玩家可以附身世界中的任何动物或物件。

creators.name: Ben Esposito
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏设计师，洛杉矶
creators.bio: Game designer who made Donut County; earlier worked on The Unfinished Swan.
creators.bio_zh: 游戏设计师，创作了 Donut County，曾参与 The Unfinished Swan。
creators.why: Donut County makes the player a hole in the ground, an unusual object to become.
creators.why_zh: Donut County 让玩家成为地上的一个洞，一种不寻常的“物”。

creators.name: Samurai Punk
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室，墨尔本
creators.bio: Melbourne studio that made Screencheat and the bird-flight game Feather.
creators.bio_zh: 墨尔本工作室，作品有 Screencheat 与飞鸟游戏 Feather。
creators.why: Feather is a goal-free flight game about simply being a bird.
creators.why_zh: Feather 是一款没有目标、只关于“做一只鸟”的飞行游戏。

creators.name: EpiXR Games
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室，德国
creators.bio: Small German studio behind the Aery series of calm bird-flight games, with a VR edition.
creators.bio_zh: 德国小型工作室，开发了平静的鸟类飞行游戏系列 Aery，并推出 VR 版。
creators.why: Aery offers bird flight as a relaxing, non-competitive experience on screen and in VR.
creators.why_zh: Aery 把鸟类飞行做成放松、无竞争的屏幕与 VR 体验。

creators.name: Krillbite Studio
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室，挪威
creators.bio: Norwegian studio founded by students; made The Plan, Among the Sleep and Mosaic.
creators.bio_zh: 由学生创立的挪威工作室，作品有 The Plan、Among the Sleep 与 Mosaic。
creators.why: The Plan is a short art game lived entirely as a housefly.
creators.why_zh: The Plan 是一部完全以苍蝇身份体验的短篇艺术游戏。

creators.name: Old B1ood
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室
creators.bio: Small studio that made the fish survival sandbox Feed and Grow: Fish.
creators.bio_zh: 小型工作室，开发了鱼类生存沙盒游戏 Feed and Grow: Fish。
creators.why: Feed and Grow: Fish is a popular sandbox for being many real fish species.
creators.why_zh: Feed and Grow: Fish 是可以扮演多种真实鱼类的热门沙盒游戏。

creators.name: Crispy's!
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室，东京
creators.bio: Studio founded by Yohei Kataoka; co-developed Tokyo Jungle with Sony's Japan Studio.
creators.bio_zh: 由片冈阳平创立的工作室，与索尼 Japan Studio 共同开发《东京丛林》。
creators.why: Tokyo Jungle lets players live short animal lives in a Tokyo without people.
creators.why_zh: 《东京丛林》让玩家在没有人类的东京度过短暂的动物一生。

creators.name: Zoom Inc.
creators.role_zh: 游戏开发商，日本
creators.bio: Japanese developer that made Mister Mosquito (Ka) for PlayStation 2.
creators.bio_zh: 日本开发商，为 PlayStation 2 开发了《蚊》（Mister Mosquito）。
creators.why: Mister Mosquito turns the human body into terrain seen by a feeding insect.
creators.why_zh: 《蚊》把人体变成一只觅食昆虫眼中的地形。

creators.name: Frontier Developments
creators.role_zh: 游戏开发商，剑桥
creators.bio: British developer founded by David Braben; made Elite: Dangerous, Planet Zoo and the PS2 game Dog's Life.
creators.bio_zh: 由 David Braben 创立的英国开发商，作品有 Elite: Dangerous、Planet Zoo 与 PS2 游戏 Dog's Life。
creators.why: Dog's Life visualised a dog's sense of smell as coloured scent clouds.
creators.why_zh: Dog's Life 把狗的嗅觉可视化为彩色的气味云。

creators.name: Revolutionary Games Studio
creators.role_zh: 志愿者参与的开源游戏项目
creators.bio: International volunteer community developing Thrive, a free, open-source evolution game guided by biology.
creators.bio_zh: 由国际志愿者社区开发 Thrive，这是一款免费、开源、以生物学为依据的演化游戏。
creators.why: Thrive tries to make the microbe stage scientifically grounded, with membranes, organelles and chemistry.
creators.why_zh: Thrive 试图让微生物阶段有科学依据，包括细胞膜、细胞器与化学过程。

creators.name: Nintendo
creators.role_zh: 游戏公司，京都
creators.bio: Japanese game company; Mole Mania was produced by Shigeru Miyamoto.
creators.bio_zh: 日本游戏公司；Mole Mania 由宫本茂担任制作人。
creators.why: Mole Mania is an early game about living on two layers, above and below ground.
creators.why_zh: Mole Mania 是早期关于在地上与地下两层之间生活的游戏。

works.title: Eagle Flight
works.description: A VR game in which you fly as an eagle over a Paris abandoned by humans and overgrown by nature, racing and fighting other eagles.
works.description_zh: 一款 VR 游戏：你化身老鹰，在人类离开、被自然重新占据的巴黎上空飞翔，与其他老鹰竞速和争斗。
works.idea_en: Flight steered by the head: the eagle's body is mapped onto the steadiest part of yours, so looking is flying.
works.idea_zh: 用头部掌舵的飞行：老鹰的身体被映射到你身上最稳定的部位——头，于是“看”就是“飞”。
works.method: Head orientation steers the eagle on Oculus Rift, HTC Vive and PlayStation VR, with a comfort vignette that narrows the view in turns.
works.method_zh: 在 Oculus Rift、HTC Vive 与 PlayStation VR 上用头部朝向操控老鹰，转弯时视野边缘收窄以减轻晕动。

works.title: Tentacular
works.description: A VR puzzle game in which you are a giant, good-natured sea creature whose arms are two long tentacles, used to lift, stack and fling objects around a harbour island.
works.description_zh: 一款 VR 解谜游戏：你是一只巨大而善良的海怪，双臂是两条长长的触手，用来在港口小岛上举起、堆叠和甩动物件。
works.idea_en: Hands without bones: precise human tasks turn into floppy physics, and giant scale makes the human world feel like toys.
works.idea_zh: 没有骨头的手：精细的人类动作变成软绵绵的物理，而巨大的尺度让人类世界像玩具一样。
works.method: Motion controllers drive physically simulated tentacles with suction-cup grabbing on Meta Quest and SteamVR.
works.method_zh: 在 Meta Quest 与 SteamVR 上，运动手柄驱动带吸盘抓取的物理模拟触手。

works.title: Gorilla Tag
works.description: A multiplayer VR game in which players are legless gorillas who move only by pushing their hands against the ground, walls and trees, playing tag.
works.description_zh: 一款多人 VR 游戏：玩家是没有腿的大猩猩，只能用手推地面、墙壁和树木来移动，彼此玩捉人游戏。
works.idea_en: Walking on your hands: remove the legs and the body learns ape locomotion through the arms, a body swap millions of players adopted.
works.idea_zh: 用手行走：去掉双腿，身体便通过手臂学会类人猿的移动方式——这是数百万玩家接受的一次身体交换。
works.method: Controller positions push a physics body with no joystick locomotion; first released in early access on Meta Quest and SteamVR, originally made by Kerestell Smith.
works.method_zh: 没有摇杆移动，手柄位置直接推动物理身体；最初由 Kerestell Smith 开发，先在 Meta Quest 与 SteamVR 抢先体验发布。

works.title: I Am Cat
works.description: A VR sandbox in which you are a house cat in an old woman's home: you climb furniture, knock objects off shelves and hide from the owner.
works.description_zh: 一款 VR 沙盒游戏：你是老奶奶家里的一只猫，爬家具、把东西从架子上拍下去，并躲着主人。
works.idea_en: Cat scale: shrinking the player to cat height and turning hands into paws makes an ordinary home into terrain.
works.idea_zh: 猫的尺度：把玩家缩到猫的高度、把双手变成爪子，普通的家就成了地形。
works.method: Hand-driven paw controls with arm-based climbing and jumping on Meta Quest and SteamVR.
works.method_zh: 在 Meta Quest 与 SteamVR 上用手控制猫爪，靠手臂动作攀爬和跳跃。

works.title: I Am Bird
works.description: A VR sandbox in which you are a city bird that flaps its arms to fly, steals food and causes chaos in the streets.
works.description_zh: 一款 VR 沙盒游戏：你是一只城市里的鸟，扇动手臂飞行，偷食物，在街头制造混乱。
works.idea_en: Arms as wings: flight is produced by flapping, so the player's own effort becomes lift.
works.idea_zh: 手臂即翅膀：飞行靠扇动产生，玩家自己的力气变成了升力。
works.method: Arm-flapping motion tracked by the controllers generates lift and steering on Meta Quest.
works.method_zh: 在 Meta Quest 上，手柄追踪扇臂动作以产生升力并控制方向。

works.title: I Am Monkey
works.description: A VR sandbox in which you are a monkey in a zoo cage; visitors pass by, some offering bananas, others teasing, and you can charm them or fight back.
works.description_zh: 一款 VR 沙盒游戏：你是动物园笼中的一只猴子；游客来来往往，有人递香蕉，有人挑衅，你可以讨好他们，也可以反击。
works.idea_en: The zoo gaze reversed: the player is the one on display, looking out through bars at people.
works.idea_zh: 被反转的动物园凝视：玩家成了被观看的一方，隔着栏杆看人。
works.method: Arm-based climbing, grabbing and throwing with scripted visitor behaviour on Meta Quest and Steam.
works.method_zh: 在 Meta Quest 与 Steam 上用手臂攀爬、抓取和投掷，游客行为由脚本驱动。

works.title: I Am Octopus
works.description: A VR platformer in which you are an octopus captured by a scientist; you stretch your tentacles to fling, pull and launch yourself through test chambers.
works.description_zh: 一款 VR 平台游戏：你是一只被科学家抓住的章鱼，伸出触手甩动、拉扯、弹射自己，穿过一个个试验场。
works.idea_en: Moving by arms alone: locomotion is stretching, sticking and releasing tentacles rather than walking.
works.idea_zh: 只靠手臂移动：行动方式是伸展、吸附和松开触手，而不是走路。
works.method: Hand-based tentacle locomotion on Meta Quest, released in early access; made by David Chaseling and Dylan Van Beek.
works.method_zh: Meta Quest 上以手驱动的触手移动，抢先体验发布；由 David Chaseling 与 Dylan Van Beek 开发。

works.title: Be A Chameleon
works.description: A VR game in which you are a chameleon escaping a pet shop: you swing on your sticky tongue, climb walls and change colour to hide from staff.
works.description_zh: 一款 VR 游戏：你是一只想逃出宠物店的变色龙，用黏黏的舌头荡来荡去、爬墙，并变换颜色躲避店员。
works.idea_en: Camouflage as a verb: blending into the background is the chameleon's main action, alongside a tongue used as a limb.
works.idea_zh: 伪装即动作：融入背景是变色龙的主要行为，舌头则被当作一条肢体来用。
works.method: Tongue grappling, hand-based climbing and colour matching against surfaces on Meta Quest, with a Steam release planned.
works.method_zh: 在 Meta Quest 上用舌头钩抓、用手攀爬，并与表面进行颜色匹配；计划登陆 Steam。

works.title: Stifled
works.description: A horror game played in darkness: the world appears only where sound bounces off it, and in VR the player's own voice, picked up by a microphone, lights up the room.
works.description_zh: 一款在黑暗中进行的恐怖游戏：世界只在声音反弹之处显现；在 VR 中，麦克风收录的玩家自己的声音会照亮房间。
works.idea_en: Echolocation as the only light: making noise lets you see, but it also lets the monsters hear you.
works.idea_zh: 回声定位是唯一的光：发出声音让你看见，也让怪物听见你。
works.method: Microphone input and in-game sounds trigger expanding outlines on nearby geometry; released for PlayStation VR and PC.
works.method_zh: 麦克风输入与游戏内声音触发附近几何体上扩散的轮廓线；登陆 PlayStation VR 与 PC。

works.title: Catlateral Damage
works.description: A first-person game in which you are a house cat trying to knock as many objects as possible onto the floor before time runs out.
works.description_zh: 一款第一人称游戏：你是一只家猫，要在时间用完前把尽可能多的东西拍到地上。
works.idea_en: The first-person cat: paws in view and physics objects to swat turn a cat's mischief into the whole game.
works.idea_zh: 第一人称的猫：视野中的爪子与可拍落的物理物件，把猫的调皮变成了整个游戏。
works.method: First-person paw swipes on physics-simulated household objects, with optional VR support on PC.
works.method_zh: 第一人称用猫爪拍打物理模拟的家居物件，PC 版支持可选 VR。

works.title: Everything
works.description: A game in which you can become anything in the universe, from animals and plants to planets, galaxies and atoms, moving freely between scales while recordings of Alan Watts play.
works.description_zh: 一款游戏：你可以成为宇宙中的任何事物，从动物、植物到行星、星系与原子，在尺度之间自由穿行，背景是 Alan Watts 的演讲录音。
works.idea_en: Becoming as a continuum: every thing can be inhabited, and the main move is changing scale rather than acting.
works.idea_zh: “成为”是一条连续谱：任何事物都可以被栖居，主要的动作是改变尺度，而不是行动。
works.method: A procedural world of thousands of low-poly things that the player can 'ascend' to larger or 'descend' to smaller; animals roll rather than walk.
works.method_zh: 由数千个低多边形物体构成的程序化世界，玩家可以“上升”到更大的尺度或“下降”到更小的尺度；动物用翻滚代替行走。
shown_at: Vienna Shorts 2017 (jury award, first game eligible for an Academy Award)

works.title: Mountain
works.description: An ambient game in which you are a mountain floating in space; seasons pass, objects crash into you and stay, and you can only watch and play notes.
works.description_zh: 一款氛围游戏：你是一座漂浮在太空中的山；四季更替，物体撞上来并留下，你只能看着，偶尔弹几个音。
works.idea_en: Being a mountain means being almost passive: the experience is the time scale, not control.
works.idea_zh: 成为一座山几乎意味着被动：体验的是时间尺度，而不是控制。
works.method: After the player answers drawing prompts to seed the mountain, it runs on its own with simulated weather and seasons; the keyboard only plays notes.
works.method_zh: 玩家先按提示作画以生成山体，之后山自行运转，天气与季节由模拟生成；键盘只能弹奏音符。

works.title: Flower
works.description: A game in which you are the wind, gathering a stream of petals across fields and bringing colour and life back to a grey landscape.
works.description_zh: 一款游戏：你是风，卷起一串花瓣掠过原野，让灰暗的大地重新恢复色彩与生机。
works.idea_en: Becoming wind: the player has no body, only a direction and a gust.
works.idea_zh: 成为风：玩家没有身体，只有方向与一阵气流。
works.method: Tilting the PlayStation 3 SIXAXIS controller steers the wind and pressing any button makes it blow harder.
works.method_zh: 倾斜 PlayStation 3 的 SIXAXIS 手柄来操控风向，按任意键让风变强。
shown_at: The Art of Video Games, Smithsonian American Art Museum 2012

works.title: flOw
works.description: A game in which you guide an aquatic microorganism that eats other organisms, grows new segments and dives through the layers of a primordial ocean.
works.description_zh: 一款游戏：你引导一只水生微生物吞食其他生物、长出新的体节，并潜入原始海洋的一层层深处。
works.idea_en: Being a microorganism whose body grows with what it eats, paced by the theory of flow.
works.idea_zh: 成为一只微生物：身体随所吃之物而生长，节奏依据“心流”理论设计。
works.method: Made as Jenova Chen's master's thesis at USC as a Flash game, then rebuilt for PlayStation 3 with tilt control.
works.method_zh: 最初是陈星汉在南加州大学的硕士论文 Flash 游戏，后为 PlayStation 3 重制并加入体感倾斜操控。
shown_at: The Museum of Modern Art collection (2012)

works.title: Osmos
works.description: A physics game in which you are a floating mote that grows by absorbing smaller motes; to move you must eject part of your own mass.
works.description_zh: 一款物理游戏：你是一个漂浮的微粒，靠吸收更小的微粒长大；想要移动，就必须喷出自身的一部分。
works.idea_en: Movement costs body: a cell-like being in which every push shrinks the self.
works.idea_zh: 移动要付出身体：在这个类似细胞的存在中，每一次推进都会让自己变小。
works.method: Newtonian physics with mass ejection as propulsion and adjustable time speed.
works.method_zh: 基于牛顿物理，以喷射质量作为推进，并可调节时间流速。

works.title: Spore
works.description: A game in which you evolve a species from a single cell to a space-faring civilisation, designing its body in a creature editor and then living in it.
works.description_zh: 一款游戏：你让一个物种从单细胞演化为星际文明，在生物编辑器中设计它的身体，然后住进这具身体。
works.idea_en: Design a body, then inhabit it: procedural animation makes any limb layout walk, eat and dance.
works.idea_zh: 先设计身体，再栖居其中：程序化动画让任意的肢体布局都能行走、进食和跳舞。
works.method: A creature editor with procedural animation that adapts gait and gestures to whatever body the player builds; led by Will Wright.
works.method_zh: 生物编辑器配合程序化动画，能根据玩家搭建的任何身体调整步态与动作；由 Will Wright 主导。

works.title: SimAnt
works.description: A simulation in which you control one yellow ant and, through it, a whole colony competing with red ants for a suburban backyard and house.
works.description_zh: 一款模拟游戏：你控制一只黄蚂蚁，并借由它带领整个蚁群，与红蚂蚁争夺郊区的后院和房子。
works.idea_en: One ant and the colony at once: the player switches between an individual body and a superorganism, guided by pheromone trails.
works.idea_zh: 同时是一只蚂蚁和整个蚁群：玩家在个体身体与超个体之间切换，由信息素轨迹引导。
works.method: Colony simulation with pheromone trails, castes and recruitment; designed by Will Wright, drawing on Hölldobler and Wilson's The Ants.
works.method_zh: 包含信息素轨迹、分工与招募的蚁群模拟；由 Will Wright 设计，参考了 Hölldobler 与 Wilson 的 The Ants。

works.title: Mushroom 11
works.description: A puzzle-platformer in which you control an amorphous green organism by erasing parts of it; the lost cells regrow elsewhere, so it moves by being destroyed.
works.description_zh: 一款解谜平台游戏：你通过擦除来操控一团无定形的绿色有机体；被擦掉的细胞会在别处重新长出，于是它靠被破坏而前进。
works.idea_en: Movement by self-erasure: a body with no fixed shape, steered by removing cells rather than moving limbs.
works.idea_zh: 以自我擦除来移动：一个没有固定形状的身体，靠移除细胞而非挥动肢体来操控。
works.method: A mouse eraser deletes cells and the organism regrows the same number of cells on its other side; soundtrack by The Future Sound of London.
works.method_zh: 用鼠标“橡皮擦”删掉细胞，有机体会在另一侧长回同样数量的细胞；配乐由 The Future Sound of London 创作。

works.title: Carrion
works.description: A 'reverse horror' game in which you are an amorphous tentacled creature escaping a research facility, growing as you consume and squeezing through vents.
works.description_zh: 一款“反向恐怖”游戏：你是一团无定形的触手生物，正在逃离研究设施，吞食越多就越大，还能挤过通风管。
works.idea_en: The monster's body: many tentacles grab the world at once and the body's size changes what it can do.
works.idea_zh: 怪物的身体：许多触手同时抓住世界，身体的大小决定了它能做什么。
works.method: A procedurally animated mass of tentacles in 2D pixel art, controlled by pointing where it should reach.
works.method_zh: 2D 像素风格下程序化驱动的一团触手，玩家指向哪里它就伸向哪里。

works.title: Thrive
works.description: An open-source evolution game that starts in the microbe stage: you are a single cell in a tide pool, absorbing compounds, engulfing prey and redesigning your membrane and organelles between generations.
works.description_zh: 一款开源演化游戏，从微生物阶段开始：你是潮池中的一个单细胞，吸收化合物、吞噬猎物，并在世代之间重新设计细胞膜与细胞器。
works.idea_en: Being a cell with real biology: metabolism, membranes and organelles are what limit and shape the body.
works.idea_zh: 成为一个遵循真实生物学的细胞：新陈代谢、细胞膜与细胞器决定并塑造着这具身体。
works.method: A cell editor with organelles, membrane types and compound balances simulated per patch of an auto-generated planet; free open-source builds, Steam early access from 2021.
works.method_zh: 细胞编辑器包含细胞器、膜类型与化合物平衡，按自动生成星球上的各个区块进行模拟；提供免费开源版本，2021 年起在 Steam 抢先体验。

works.title: Shelter
works.description: As a mother badger you lead five cubs from their burrow through forest, river and fire to a new home, feeding them and guarding them from a bird of prey.
works.description_zh: 你是一只獾妈妈，带着五只幼崽离开洞穴，穿过森林、河流与山火前往新家，一路喂养它们并防备猛禽。
works.idea_en: Becoming a parent animal: care and vulnerability, not power, are the mechanics.
works.idea_zh: 成为动物父母：游戏机制是照料与脆弱，而不是力量。
works.method: Third-person play in a painted, low-poly world where cub AI follows the mother and can starve or be taken.
works.method_zh: 在绘画质感的低多边形世界中以第三人称进行，幼崽由 AI 控制跟随母亲，可能饿死或被掠走。

works.title: Shelter 2
works.description: As a lynx mother you give birth, hunt across tundra and forest and raise your cubs until they can survive alone.
works.description_zh: 你是一只猞猁妈妈，生下幼崽，在苔原与森林中狩猎，把孩子们养大到能独立生存。
works.idea_en: A predator's parenthood: hunting is the way to keep others alive.
works.idea_zh: 捕食者的育儿：狩猎是让他者活下去的方式。
works.method: Open-world third-person play with hunting, cub growth across seasons and cubs that can be carried on to later play.
works.method_zh: 开放世界第三人称玩法，包括狩猎、幼崽随季节成长，幼崽可延续到后续游戏中。

works.title: Paws - A Shelter 2 Game
works.description: A standalone adventure in which you are a young lynx cub finding its way home through a large world after losing its family.
works.description_zh: 一款独立冒险游戏：你是一只失去家人的小猞猁，穿越广阔世界寻找回家的路。
works.idea_en: The world at cub scale: loss and friendship seen from the smallest and weakest body.
works.idea_zh: 幼崽尺度下的世界：从最小、最弱的身体看失去与友谊。
works.method: Third-person exploration with climbing and simple animal interactions in the Shelter art style.
works.method_zh: 以 Shelter 系列画风进行的第三人称探索，包括攀爬与简单的动物互动。

works.title: Meadow - A Shelter Game
works.description: A multiplayer game in which players, as badgers, rabbits, deer and other animals, meet anonymously and communicate only through animal calls and gestures.
works.description_zh: 一款多人游戏：玩家化身獾、兔、鹿等动物匿名相遇，只能用动物叫声和动作交流。
works.idea_en: Social life without language: strangers become a herd through sound and body alone.
works.idea_zh: 没有语言的社交：陌生人只靠声音和身体结成群体。
works.method: Online multiplayer with no text or voice chat; expression is limited to animal sounds, emotes and following one another.
works.method_zh: 在线多人，没有文字或语音聊天；表达仅限于动物叫声、动作与相互跟随。

works.title: Shelter 3
works.description: As an elephant matriarch you lead your herd and calf across open landscapes, gathering them in danger and searching for water and shelter.
works.description_zh: 你是一头大象女族长，带领象群与幼象穿越开阔大地，在危险时召集它们，寻找水源与庇护所。
works.idea_en: Herd as body: care is extended from one calf to a whole family that moves together.
works.idea_zh: 群体即身体：照料从一头幼象扩展到一起行动的整个家族。
works.method: Third-person herd simulation in which followers respond to the matriarch's calls and position.
works.method_zh: 第三人称象群模拟，跟随者会对女族长的叫声与位置作出反应。

works.title: Stray
works.description: A third-person adventure in which you are a stray cat separated from its family in a walled cybercity inhabited by robots; you climb, meow, scratch and squeeze through gaps.
works.description_zh: 一款第三人称冒险游戏：你是一只与家人走散的流浪猫，身处住满机器人的封闭赛博城市，攀爬、喵叫、抓挠、钻缝。
works.idea_en: Cat affordances: every ledge, pipe and doormat is read the way a cat would read it, including a dedicated meow button.
works.idea_zh: 猫的可供性：每一处窗台、管道和门垫都按猫的方式被解读，甚至有专门的“喵”键。
works.method: Context-sensitive jumps between surfaces, cat animation likely based on reference footage of real cats, and a camera kept at cat height.
works.method_zh: 情境式跳跃让猫在各个表面之间移动，动画很可能参考了真实猫的影像，镜头保持在猫的高度。
shown_at: The Game Awards 2022 (Best Independent Game, Best Debut Indie Game)

works.title: Little Kitty, Big City
works.description: An open-world game in which you are a small black kitten who has fallen from a window and explores a Japanese-inspired city to find the way home.
works.description_zh: 一款开放世界游戏：你是一只从窗台跌落的小黑猫，在一座日式风格的城市中探索，寻找回家的路。
works.idea_en: The city at kitten scale: street furniture, birds and people are obstacles and playmates.
works.idea_zh: 小猫尺度下的城市：街道设施、鸟和人既是障碍也是玩伴。
works.method: Third-person climbing, napping and object interactions tuned to a kitten's body.
works.method_zh: 针对小猫身体调整的第三人称攀爬、打盹与物件互动。

works.title: Untitled Goose Game
works.description: A stealth comedy in which you are a goose who ruins villagers' days by stealing, honking and hiding.
works.description_zh: 一款潜行喜剧游戏：你是一只鹅，靠偷东西、嘎嘎叫和躲藏来搅乱村民的一天。
works.idea_en: Counterpoint: the animal body is used for mischief and slapstick, not perception, and it works because the goose stays a goose.
works.idea_zh: 对照案例：动物身体被用于恶作剧和闹剧而非感知；它之所以成立，是因为鹅始终是一只鹅。
works.method: Top-down third-person controls with a dedicated honk button, wing flap and beak grab.
works.method_zh: 俯视第三人称操作，设有专门的“嘎”键、拍翅与用喙叼取。
shown_at: Game Developers Choice Awards 2020 (Game of the Year)

works.title: Octodad: Dadliest Catch
works.description: An octopus disguised as a suburban father tries to do chores, shop and go to the aquarium without his family noticing he is an octopus.
works.description_zh: 一只伪装成郊区父亲的章鱼，努力做家务、购物、去水族馆，同时不让家人发现他是章鱼。
works.idea_en: A boneless body forced into human routines: the controls make the mismatch between body and task felt.
works.idea_zh: 被塞进人类日常的无骨身体：操控方式让身体与任务之间的错位变得可感。
works.method: Each leg and the arm are controlled separately by different buttons and mouse motion, over a physically simulated body; follows the 2010 DePaul student game Octodad.
works.method_zh: 双腿与手臂分别由不同按键和鼠标控制，驱动物理模拟的身体；延续了 2010 年德保罗大学的学生游戏 Octodad。

works.title: Ecco the Dolphin
works.description: A side-scrolling game in which you are a bottlenose dolphin searching for your lost pod; your sonar song maps the surroundings and speaks with other creatures, and you must surface to breathe.
works.description_zh: 一款横版游戏：你是一只宽吻海豚，寻找失散的族群；你的声呐歌声能描绘周围环境、与其他生物交谈，而你必须浮出水面呼吸。
works.idea_en: Echolocation as a game verb: the sonar song is both map and language, and the air meter reminds you that you are a mammal.
works.idea_zh: 回声定位成为游戏动作：声呐歌声既是地图也是语言，而氧气条提醒你是一只哺乳动物。
works.method: One button sends a sonar call that returns a map of the nearby area and triggers dialogue with whales and glyphs; developed by Ed Annunziata with Novotrade International for the Sega Mega Drive / Genesis.
works.method_zh: 按一个键发出声呐，返回附近区域的地图并触发与鲸和石碑的对话；由 Ed Annunziata 与 Novotrade International 为世嘉 Mega Drive / Genesis 开发。

works.title: Maneater
works.description: An open-world action game in which you are a bull shark growing from pup to monster in Gulf Coast waters, framed as a reality TV show about a shark hunter.
works.description_zh: 一款开放世界动作游戏：你是一条公牛鲨，在墨西哥湾沿岸水域从幼鲨长成巨兽，全程被包装成一档关于猎鲨人的真人秀。
works.idea_en: Counterpoint: an animal as power fantasy; the shark's senses become a gamified 'sonar' that highlights prey.
works.idea_zh: 对照案例：动物作为力量幻想；鲨鱼的感官被游戏化为一种高亮猎物的“声呐”。
works.method: Third-person swimming with body upgrades ('evolutions') and a sonar pulse that outlines prey, items and routes.
works.method_zh: 第三人称游泳，身体可“进化”升级，声呐脉冲会勾勒出猎物、物品与路线。

works.title: Bee Simulator
works.description: An open-world game in which you are a honeybee in a city park, collecting pollen, dancing to share flower locations and defending the hive.
works.description_zh: 一款开放世界游戏：你是城市公园里的一只蜜蜂，采集花粉，用舞蹈分享花的位置，并保卫蜂巢。
works.idea_en: Bee senses gamified: a 'bee vision' mode highlights pollen and scent paths, and the waggle dance is a rhythm mini-game.
works.idea_zh: 把蜜蜂感官游戏化：“蜜蜂视觉”模式会高亮花粉与气味路径，摇摆舞则是一个节奏小游戏。
works.method: Third-person flight with a toggleable sense mode, collection tasks and a dance-matching mini-game.
works.method_zh: 第三人称飞行，可切换感官模式，包含采集任务与舞步匹配小游戏。

works.title: Spirit of the North
works.description: A wordless adventure in which you are a red fox travelling through Icelandic landscapes, joined by a guardian spirit of the Northern Lights.
works.description_zh: 一款无对白的冒险游戏：你是一只赤狐，在冰岛风景中旅行，身边有北极光的守护灵相伴。
works.idea_en: Landscape at fox height, told without words.
works.idea_zh: 以狐狸的高度看风景，全程没有语言。
works.method: Third-person exploration and light puzzles using a spirit ability that separates from the fox's body.
works.method_zh: 第三人称探索与轻度解谜，使用一种可以离开狐狸身体的灵体能力。

works.title: Lost Ember
works.description: An adventure in which you are a wolf who can inhabit other animals, such as a wombat, duck, fish and hummingbird, to cross a ruined land with a spirit companion.
works.description_zh: 一款冒险游戏：你是一只能附身其他动物的狼，可以化身袋熊、鸭子、鱼、蜂鸟等，与一个灵魂同伴穿越荒废的大地。
works.idea_en: Switching bodies: each animal opens a different way of moving through the same world.
works.idea_zh: 切换身体：每种动物都打开了穿越同一世界的不同方式。
works.method: Third-person play where the player jumps into nearby animals, each with its own movement set.
works.method_zh: 第三人称玩法，玩家可以跳入附近的动物，每种动物有各自的动作系统。

works.title: Goat Simulator
works.description: A sandbox in which you are a goat who headbutts, licks and wrecks a small town, with deliberately broken ragdoll physics.
works.description_zh: 一款沙盒游戏：你是一只山羊，在小镇里顶撞、舔东西、到处搞破坏，物理效果被故意做得很“坏”。
works.idea_en: Counterpoint: a parody of animal simulation, where the goat is an excuse for physics comedy.
works.idea_zh: 对照案例：动物模拟的戏仿，山羊只是物理喜剧的借口。
works.method: Ragdoll physics with a sticky tongue and headbutt, built quickly from a game-jam prototype.
works.method_zh: 布娃娃物理配合黏舌与头槌，由 Game Jam 原型快速扩展而成。

works.title: WolfQuest
works.description: A wildlife simulation made with the Minnesota Zoo in which you are a gray wolf in Yellowstone, hunting elk, finding a mate, defending territory and raising pups.
works.description_zh: 一款与明尼苏达动物园合作开发的野生动物模拟游戏：你是黄石公园的一只灰狼，捕猎马鹿、寻找伴侣、守卫领地、养育幼崽。
works.idea_en: Science-based wolf life: survival follows real ecology, and a scent view reveals prey and territory marks.
works.idea_zh: 以科学为基础的狼的生活：生存遵循真实的生态规律，“嗅觉视图”会显示猎物与领地标记。
works.method: 3D simulation of Yellowstone's Lamar Valley and Slough Creek with a scent-view mode and multiplayer packs, first funded by the US National Science Foundation.
works.method_zh: 对黄石公园 Lamar Valley 与 Slough Creek 的 3D 模拟，有嗅觉视图模式与多人狼群，最初由美国国家科学基金会资助。

works.title: Endling - Extinction is Forever
works.description: An adventure in which you are the last mother fox on an Earth damaged by humans, foraging at night to feed four cubs while avoiding people and their machines.
works.description_zh: 一款冒险游戏：你是被人类破坏的地球上最后一只狐狸妈妈，夜里觅食喂养四只幼崽，同时避开人类与他们的机器。
works.idea_en: Extinction from inside a fox family: environmental damage is felt as hunger and danger for your cubs.
works.idea_zh: 从一个狐狸家庭内部经历灭绝：环境破坏被感受为幼崽的饥饿与危险。
works.method: 2.5D side-on exploration with a day-night cycle and a scent-tracking sense that leaves visible trails.
works.method_zh: 2.5D 侧视探索，有昼夜循环以及留下可见痕迹的嗅觉追踪感官。

works.title: AWAY: The Survival Series
works.description: A survival adventure styled as a nature documentary, in which you are a sugar glider gliding between trees and fending off predators to protect your family.
works.description_zh: 一款以自然纪录片风格呈现的生存冒险游戏：你是一只蜜袋鼯，在树间滑翔、击退捕食者以保护家人。
works.idea_en: The documentary subject becomes the player: a narrator describes the animal the player is controlling.
works.idea_zh: 纪录片的拍摄对象变成了玩家：旁白描述的正是玩家操控的动物。
works.method: Third-person gliding and climbing with documentary-style narration and cameras.
works.method_zh: 第三人称滑翔与攀爬，配以纪录片式旁白与镜头。

works.title: Rain World
works.description: A survival platformer in which you are a slugcat, a small prey animal in a ruined industrial ecosystem of predators, forced to find shelter before deadly rains.
works.description_zh: 一款生存平台游戏：你是一只“蛞蝓猫”，在满是捕食者的废弃工业生态中身为弱小猎物，必须在致命暴雨来临前找到庇护所。
works.idea_en: Being low in a food chain: other creatures follow their own lives, and the player is one animal among many.
works.idea_zh: 身处食物链低端：其他生物按自己的方式生活，玩家只是众多动物中的一只。
works.method: Procedurally animated creatures with autonomous AI that hunt, flee and interact independently of the player.
works.method_zh: 程序化动画的生物拥有自主 AI，会独立于玩家狩猎、逃跑与互动。

works.title: Ōkami
works.description: An action-adventure in which you are Amaterasu, the Japanese sun goddess in the form of a white wolf, restoring a cursed land to life by painting on the world with a celestial brush.
works.description_zh: 一款动作冒险游戏：你是以白狼形态出现的日本太阳女神天照，用“笔神”在世界上作画，让被诅咒的大地复苏。
works.idea_en: A wolf body with a painter's gesture: restoring nature is done by drawing, in a sumi-e world.
works.idea_zh: 狼的身体加上画师的手势：在水墨风格的世界里，通过绘画让自然复苏。
works.method: Cel-shaded sumi-e rendering; pausing the game turns the screen into paper on which brush strokes cast spells.
works.method_zh: 卡通渲染的水墨画风；暂停后屏幕变成画纸，笔触即法术。

works.title: Tchia
works.description: An open-world game set in an archipelago inspired by New Caledonia, where a 'Soul Jump' lets you take control of any animal or object.
works.description_zh: 一款以新喀里多尼亚为灵感的群岛开放世界游戏，“灵魂跳跃”让你可以操控任何动物或物件。
works.idea_en: Soul jumping: birds, dogs, fish, rocks and lamps can all be inhabited, each with its own abilities.
works.idea_zh: 灵魂跳跃：鸟、狗、鱼、石头、灯都能被附身，各有不同能力。
works.method: A timed possession mechanic swaps the player's controls to the target creature's or object's movement set.
works.method_zh: 限时附身机制把玩家的操作切换到目标生物或物件的动作系统。

works.title: Snake Pass
works.description: A physics puzzle-platformer in which you are Noodle the snake; with no jump, you must coil around bamboo poles and grip to climb.
works.description_zh: 一款物理解谜平台游戏：你是一条名叫 Noodle 的蛇，不能跳，只能缠绕竹竿、抓紧往上爬。
works.idea_en: Thinking like a snake: movement is coiling and grip, and you must plan with your whole body.
works.idea_zh: 像蛇一样思考：移动就是盘绕与抓握，必须用整个身体来规划。
works.method: A physics-driven spine controlled with separate inputs for slithering forward, raising the head and tightening grip.
works.method_zh: 物理驱动的脊柱，用不同按键分别控制向前游动、抬头与收紧。

works.title: Tokyo Jungle
works.description: A survival game set in a Tokyo without people, where you play as Pomeranians, deer, lions and dozens of other animals, eating, marking territory and breeding the next generation.
works.description_zh: 一款生存游戏，舞台是没有人类的东京：你可以扮演博美犬、鹿、狮子等数十种动物，进食、标记领地、繁育下一代。
works.idea_en: Generational survival: each animal lives a short life and the player continues as its offspring.
works.idea_zh: 代际生存：每只动物只有短暂的一生，玩家以它的后代继续下去。
works.method: Side-on survival with hunger, territory marking, mating and aging over in-game years; co-developed with Sony's Japan Studio for PlayStation 3.
works.method_zh: 侧视生存玩法，包含饥饿、领地标记、交配与随游戏年份衰老；与索尼 Japan Studio 合作为 PlayStation 3 开发。

works.title: Dog's Life
works.description: An adventure in which you are Jake, a dog searching for a friend; 'Smellovision' switches to a dog's-eye view in which scents appear as coloured clouds.
works.description_zh: 一款冒险游戏：你是一只名叫 Jake 的狗，在寻找朋友；“嗅觉视图”会切换到狗的视角，气味以彩色云团呈现。
works.idea_en: Canine smell made visible: the world desaturates and odours become coloured clouds to follow.
works.idea_zh: 让狗的嗅觉可见：世界褪色，气味变成可追踪的彩色云团。
works.method: A first-person smell mode that drains colour from the scene and overlays coloured scent sources on PlayStation 2.
works.method_zh: PlayStation 2 上的第一人称嗅觉模式，让场景褪色并叠加彩色气味源。

works.title: Mole Mania
works.description: A Game Boy puzzle game in which you are Muddy Mole, digging between the surface and an underground layer to push a heavy iron ball through each screen.
works.description_zh: 一款 Game Boy 解谜游戏：你是鼹鼠 Muddy，在地表与地下两层之间挖洞，把沉重的铁球推过每一屏。
works.idea_en: A two-layer world: burrowing lets the mole pass under obstacles that block it above ground.
works.idea_zh: 两层世界：挖洞让鼹鼠可以从地下绕过地面上挡路的障碍。
works.method: Top-down puzzles on two linked maps, surface and underground, with dig holes as transitions; produced by Shigeru Miyamoto.
works.method_zh: 在地表与地下两张相连的俯视地图上解谜，挖出的洞就是通道；由宫本茂担任制作人。

works.title: Webbed
works.description: A 2D physics platformer in which you are a small peacock spider who spins webs to swing, build bridges and move objects to rescue a partner.
works.description_zh: 一款 2D 物理平台游戏：你是一只小小的孔雀蜘蛛，吐丝荡秋千、搭桥、移动物体，去营救伴侣。
works.idea_en: Silk as an extended body: the web is a tool, a path and a limb at once.
works.idea_zh: 蛛丝是延伸的身体：网同时是工具、道路与肢体。
works.method: Physically simulated silk strands that can be anchored, tensioned and cut.
works.method_zh: 物理模拟的蛛丝，可以锚定、拉紧与剪断。

works.title: Empire of the Ants
works.description: A photorealistic strategy adventure in which you are ant no. 103,683, exploring the forest floor and commanding a colony through the seasons; based on Bernard Werber's novel.
works.description_zh: 一款照片级真实的策略冒险游戏：你是 103,683 号蚂蚁，探索森林地面并带领蚁群度过四季；改编自 Bernard Werber 的小说。
works.idea_en: Ant scale made photoreal: leaves, drops and moss become architecture, and one ant directs a superorganism.
works.idea_zh: 照片级的蚂蚁尺度：落叶、水滴和苔藓变成建筑，一只蚂蚁指挥一个超个体。
works.method: Unreal Engine 5 rendering of real forest scenes at ant scale, combining third-person exploration with real-time strategy.
works.method_zh: 用 Unreal Engine 5 以蚂蚁尺度渲染真实森林场景，结合第三人称探索与即时战略。

works.title: The Plan
works.description: A short, free game in which you fly as a housefly upward through a dark forest toward a light, accompanied by Grieg's In the Hall of the Mountain King.
works.description_zh: 一款短小的免费游戏：你是一只苍蝇，在黑暗的森林中向上飞向光亮，伴随着格里格的《在山魔王的宫殿里》。
works.idea_en: A life at fly scale: a slow ascent that makes a tiny, short life feel significant.
works.idea_zh: 苍蝇尺度的一生：一段缓慢的上升，让渺小而短暂的生命显得有分量。
works.method: Simple 3D flight controls in a single continuous level scored to classical music.
works.method_zh: 简单的 3D 飞行操作，单一连续关卡，配以古典音乐。

works.title: Mister Mosquito
works.description: A stealth game in which you are a mosquito feeding on members of a Japanese family through the summer without being noticed or swatted.
works.description_zh: 一款潜行游戏：你是一只蚊子，整个夏天都要在不被察觉、不被拍死的情况下吸一家日本人的血。
works.idea_en: The human body as terrain: feeding is stealth, and the host's stress rises with every mistake.
works.idea_zh: 人体即地形：吸血是潜行，每一次失误都会让宿主的烦躁上升。
works.method: 3D flight around life-size human characters with a stress meter and pressure-sensitive analog control for how hard to suck.
works.method_zh: 围绕真人比例的角色进行 3D 飞行，有烦躁值指示，并用压感模拟摇杆控制吸血力度。

works.title: Feather
works.description: A relaxed multiplayer game in which you are a bird gliding over an island, with no goals, score or competition.
works.description_zh: 一款轻松的多人游戏：你是一只鸟，在岛屿上空滑翔，没有目标、分数或竞争。
works.idea_en: Flight without objectives: being a bird is the whole activity.
works.idea_zh: 没有目标的飞行：做一只鸟本身就是全部。
works.method: Third-person gliding with an adaptive soundtrack that responds to where and how the player flies.
works.method_zh: 第三人称滑翔，配乐会根据玩家飞行的位置与方式变化。

works.title: Aery - Little Bird Adventure
works.description: A calm flying game in which you are a small bird exploring dreamlike landscapes; a VR edition followed in 2023.
works.description_zh: 一款平静的飞行游戏：你是一只小鸟，在梦境般的风景中探索；2023 年推出 VR 版。
works.idea_en: Bird flight as rest: no combat, just gliding through places.
works.idea_zh: 把鸟的飞行当作休憩：没有战斗，只是在各处滑翔。
works.method: Third-person flight with collectibles on PC and consoles, plus a VR-supported edition with head-steered flight.
works.method_zh: PC 与主机上的第三人称飞行与收集，另有支持 VR 的版本。

works.title: Feed and Grow: Fish
works.description: A sandbox in which you start as a small fish and grow by eating other fish, unlocking many real species from piranhas to sharks.
works.description_zh: 一款沙盒游戏：你从一条小鱼开始，靠吃其他鱼长大，可以解锁从食人鱼到鲨鱼的多种真实鱼类。
works.idea_en: Size is survival: the underwater world reorganises itself as your body grows.
works.idea_zh: 体型即生存：随着身体长大，水下世界的关系随之重组。
works.method: Third-person swimming with growth-by-eating and species with different speeds and bites.
works.method_zh: 第三人称游泳，靠进食成长，不同鱼种有不同的速度与咬合方式。

works.title: I Am Bread
works.description: A physics game in which you are a slice of bread trying to become toast, moving by lifting and planting each of its four corners.
works.description_zh: 一款物理游戏：你是一片面包，想变成吐司，靠抬起和放下四个角来移动。
works.idea_en: Object embodiment through awkward control: each corner is a limb, and the kitchen becomes terrain.
works.idea_zh: 通过笨拙的操控成为物件：每个角都是一条肢体，厨房变成了地形。
works.method: Each corner mapped to a separate button or trigger with grip, over a physics-simulated slice that can get dirty or damp.
works.method_zh: 四个角分别映射到不同按键或扳机并可抓附，驱动一片会变脏或受潮的物理模拟面包。

works.title: Donut County
works.description: A physics puzzle game in which you are a hole in the ground that grows as it swallows objects, people and eventually whole buildings.
works.description_zh: 一款物理解谜游戏：你是地上的一个洞，吞下物件、人，最终吞下整栋建筑，越吞越大。
works.idea_en: Becoming absence: the player is a hole, defined only by what falls into it.
works.idea_zh: 成为“空缺”：玩家是一个洞，只由掉进来的东西来定义。
works.method: A moving hole that cuts through the physics floor and grows with each swallowed object.
works.method_zh: 一个会移动的洞切开物理地面，每吞下一件物体就变大一点。

works.title: Perception
works.description: A first-person horror game in which Cassie, a blind woman, taps her cane to reveal a haunted house in brief blue echoes.
works.description_zh: 一款第一人称恐怖游戏：盲人女性 Cassie 用手杖敲击，让闹鬼的房子在短暂的蓝色回声中显现。
works.idea_en: Echo-vision as a rendering style: the character is human, but the way sound paints space is a reference design for bat-like perception.
works.idea_zh: 回声视觉作为渲染风格：角色是人类，但声音描绘空间的方式是类蝙蝠感知的参考设计。
works.method: Every sound source briefly outlines nearby geometry in blue, which then fades back to darkness.
works.method_zh: 每个声源都会用蓝色短暂勾勒附近的几何体，随后重新没入黑暗。

leads.why: Social VR scavenging game with Gorilla Tag-style arm locomotion as small animals; derivative of Gorilla Tag.

leads.name: Spirit of the North 2 (Infuse Studio, 2025)

leads.name: Ecco the Dolphin: Defender of the Future (Appaloosa, 2000)
